sections.title: Education
sections.description: Explore the various training, certifications, and other resources below to level up your APEX expertise.

sections.title: Oracle APEX Fundamentals
sections.description: This 3-hour learning path is ideal for beginners looking for a general overview of APEX. Explore the core functionality of APEX such as the App Builder and SQL Workshop, and build your first cloud application with APEX on OCI. Closed caption is available in multiple languages, including Japanese.

sections.title: Become An Oracle APEX Developer Professional
sections.description: This 13-hour learning path is targeted for both beginners and seasoned developers that want a deeper understanding of APEX. Dive into detail for each APEX component and try out the step-by-step guided labs for a hands-on experience.

sections.title: Oracle APEX 23.2 New Features
sections.description: This 40 minute learning path explores new features and innovations in Oracle APEX 23.2.

sections.title: Oracle APEX Certification
sections.description: Take the Oracle certification exam to become an Oracle APEX Cloud Developer Certified Professional.
